mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration triggering monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
